YuE2 · Local

A new take keeps the original song and reuses its cover.

The song chooses its own ending, up to 4 minutes. An unfinished take at the limit is held for review.

Sent directly to YuE2 as the complete style, including genre and vocals. Use it for instruments, tempo, key, mood, language, production, and vocal character. These are musical directions, not guaranteed numeric constraints.

Bring your own title and lyrics

Leave blank to have your local lyric writer compose an original song.

Composition & sound controls

Native YuE2 controls. Change one at a time to compare takes.

Edit or reuse a score

A supplied score replaces automatic planning. Generated notation is saved in each take’s details. Melody-only mode ignores chord direction in the planning instruction; it does not clone a singer.

Music sampling

Temperature changes variety. Top-p/top-k limit the choices at each step. Repetition penalty discourages repeated tokens; excessive values can hurt the music.

Score sampling controls

The score uses part of the model’s context. Very long scores leave less space for music. A score that runs out of tokens is marked for review.

Sound rendering controls

32 steps, DPM 2, SGM uniform, guidance 1 and full denoising are the working defaults. Other combinations are experimental; more steps do not guarantee better music. This guidance affects sound rendering, not the lyric/score model.

Delete this song?

Permanently delete this song, its audio, cover, and all saved video versions from this library. It will leave the queue, and local playback will stop if this song is playing. This cannot be undone. Download anything you want to keep first.

Delete this API key?

Remove the key saved by this studio and stop using it for new cover requests. Music, lyrics, songs, and existing artwork stay available. A cover request already sent may still finish. This does not revoke the key in your OpenAI account.
